method.method_draft: Use the standard side notation in a triangle, interpreting the requested blank as side c=AB, opposite angle C. From the text read a=1, angle A=pi/6, angle B=pi/4. First compute the third angle: angle C=pi-pi/6-pi/4=7pi/12. Apply the sine rule c/sin C=a/sin A, so c=1* sin(7pi/12)/sin(pi/6)=2sin(7pi/12). Then expand sin(7pi/12)=sin(105°)=sin(60°+45°)=(sqrt6+sqrt2)/4, giving c=(sqrt6+sqrt2)/2.

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate construction. Read from the text that a=BC=1, angle B=pi/4, angle A=pi/6, and the target is c=AB. Place B at the origin and put AB on the positive x-axis, so A=(c,0). Since BC=1 and angle ABC=45°, point C has coordinates (cos45°, sin45°)=(sqrt2/2, sqrt2/2). At A, the ray AB points left along the negative x-axis, and angle BAC=30°, so line AC has slope tan(150°)=-1/sqrt3. Thus C lies on the line through A: y=-(x-c)/sqrt3. Substitute C=(sqrt2/2,sqrt2/2): sqrt2/2=-(sqrt2/2-c)/sqrt3, hence c=sqrt2/2+sqrt6/2=(sqrt6+sqrt2)/2.
method.CoT_raw: 用坐标法求边长 c=AB。设 B 在原点，AB 在 x 轴正半轴上，则 A=(c,0)。因为 a=BC=1，且 ∠B=π/4，所以 C 在从 B 出发与 x 轴成 45° 的射线上，故 C=(\sqrt{2}/2,\sqrt{2}/2)。又因为 ∠A=π/6，且从 A 看向 B 的方向是负 x 轴，所以 AC 与正 x 轴夹角为 150°，其斜率为 tan(150°)=-1/\sqrt{3}。于是直线 AC 的方程可写为 y=-(x-c)/\sqrt{3}。把 C=(\sqrt{2}/2,\sqrt{2}/2) 代入，得到 \sqrt{2}/2=-(\sqrt{2}/2-c)/\sqrt{3}。两边乘以 \sqrt{3}，得 \sqrt{6}/2=-\sqrt{2}/2+c，所以 c=(\sqrt{6}+\sqrt{2})/2。

method.CoT_final: Use the coordinate method to find the side length c=AB. Let B be at the origin, and AB be on the positive half of the x-axis, then A=(c,0). Because a=BC=1, and ∠B=π/4, C is on the ray starting from B and making a 45° angle with the x-axis, so C=(\sqrt{2}/2,\sqrt{2}/2). Also because ∠A=π/6, and the direction from A looking toward B is the negative x-axis, AC makes an angle of 150° with the positive x-axis, and its slope is tan(150°)=-1/\sqrt{3}. Thus the equation of line AC can be written as y=-(x-c)/\sqrt{3}. Substitute C=(\sqrt{2}/2,\sqrt{2}/2), obtaining \sqrt{2}/2=-(\sqrt{2}/2-c)/\sqrt{3}. Multiplying both sides by \sqrt{3}, we get \sqrt{6}/2=-\sqrt{2}/2+c, so c=(\sqrt{6}+\sqrt{2})/2.
